ablation.notes: Matched follow-up to the s015 output-side delta-basis lane. Keep parent, tokenizer, solver, losses, freeze mode, batch, eval contract, rank, and highpass fixed; change only style_delta_scale from 0.15 to 0.30. Seedream-oriented style-first run: rank by transfer CLIP-S, use LPIPS as a budget rather than a primary objective, and evaluate every retained checkpoint until the style curve converges. Eval infra is accelerated with batch=4, target_chunk=5, decode_batch=20 after a timing smoke showed ~2x wall-time reduction with unchanged metric surface; training-time convergence eval additionally uses transfer_only=true to skip identity pairs, while closure can still run the full board.
